lines: lodash, 145,858 B on the whiteboard-main page: the full build; lodash-es with named imports ships only what is used.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,406 B on the whiteboard-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (183 packages, 1,287 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
